caption: The depth buffer at pixel (5,5) after each fragment arrives: A passes 0.6 < 1.0 and overwrites, then B passes 0.4 < 0.6 and overwrites again. The last row is the answer — B's colour with depth 0.4, because smaller z is nearer.

spec.title: Pixel (5,5): depth, colour
spec.aria: A three-row table for pixel (5,5) with a depth cell and a colour cell: start has depth 1.0 and no colour, polygon A passes 0.6 < 1.0 so depth becomes 0.6 and colour becomes A, then polygon B passes 0.4 < 0.6 so depth becomes 0.4 and colour becomes B.
